From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@vertexai.io>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: 2028-01-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Thanks for the webinar — attendee list & recording?

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the 'Scaling LLM inference' session this morning — great material, especially the latency/quantization segment. A few asks from our side as we digest:

- Would you be able to share the attendee list (company + title + email) as a CSV? Our partnerships team wants to run a quick fit check.
- Can you send the full replay and a 3–4 minute clip we can show to our infra team?
- If there are any folks you think are good for a technical follow-up (deep-dive on Dedicated vs Private), please suggest an SDR/AE intro.

No rush on the clip — by EOB Wednesday would be ideal.

Appreciate it,
Samantha
Samantha Cole
Partnerships, VertexAI
S: (415) 555-0182

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: 2028-01-15T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for the webinar — attendee list & recording?

Hi Samantha — great to meet you on the panel today.

Attendee CSV and the edited replay are attached: attendee_export_0115.csv and replay_final_edit_v2.mp4. I've also created a short 3:30 clip that highlights our Dedicated vs Private decision checklist; attaching that clip as well (see Drive link below).

Quick notes on routing:
- We'll mark contacts who asked pricing/compliance questions as "high" interest and push to SDR queue A for immediate outreach.
- Product-trial/POC-intent mentions will be routed to SDR queue B for qualification.
- All other attendees get a 3-email nurture with the clip and an invite to a technical office hour.

Proposed SDR intro: Ben Carter (cc'd on the internal thread) will own the VertexAI outreach for any high-interest accounts. If that works for you, we'll schedule a 15-min intro so Ben can align on the ask.

Drive replay folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-replay-vertexai
HubSpot ref: HS-99827

Action items for us:
1) Share attendee CSV (attached) — done.
2) Deliver 3-min clip & full replay — done (Drive link).
3) Confirm SDR owner & schedule intro — please confirm preferred time; Ben's Calendly: https://calendly.com/ben-carter/intro-15

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com; tessa.morgan@redwood.com; ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-01-15T11:08:00-08:00
Subject: FW: Samantha/VertexAI — routing + priority tiers

Forwarding Samantha's request — keeping internal thread for routing rules and claim instructions. Attach: mql-routing-rules.md (draft).

Summary / proposed priority buckets (apply to this attendee CSV):
- HOT (Tier 1): explicit budget/procurement mention OR C-level + product questions. Auto-tag: "vertexai_hot" — push to SDR queue A, SLA: first touch <24h.
- WARM (Tier 2): technical follow-up requests, trial interest but no procurement mention. Auto-tag: "vertexai_warm" — push to SDR queue B, SLA: first touch <72h.
- NURTURE (Tier 3): attended only or content requests. Add to 3-email nurture with clip and office hour invite.

Claiming process:
- SDR queue A: claims are manual via HubSpot task. Tessa — please claim any Tier 1 accounts you can do today; otherwise flag for Ben.
- SDR queue B: rotate weekly among SDRs; Marissa, please update routing table in HubSpot by EOD Monday.

Notes:
- We will add a custom property in HubSpot: "webinar_vertexai_20280115" for segmentation and reporting.
- Related SFDC: ACCT-22377 (VertexAI)- please ensure any outbound is logged with HS-99827.

Let me know if you want me to tweak thresholds or add an expedited-credit hold for enterprise accounts.

-JW

From: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com; marissa.cole@redwood.com; ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-01-15T13:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: FW: Samantha/VertexAI — routing + priority tiers

On it — I'll start claiming Tier 1s this afternoon (4pm PT). If anything looks Enterprise-level I'll tag Ben and request a joint intro.

-Tessa

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com

Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com

Hi Samantha — quick update and next steps.

- Replay + clips: shared to Drive here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-replay-vertexai (same link as before). The 3:30 clip lives in the 'Highlights' folder.
- Attendee CSV: attached (attendee_export_0115.csv). We applied the routing rules and flagged 8 Tier-1 accounts.
- SDR intro: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.com) will reach out — he is cc'd. Ben, can you propose 15-min windows on Tue/Wed next week?

Samantha — if you'd like, we can run a short technical office hour for VertexAI engineers; happy to host a 30-min session next month.

Thanks again for partnering on amplification — we left a HubSpot note (HS-99827) summarizing outreach.

Best,
Jonas
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
